hierarchy.criterion: Parent, child, raised, and overlay surfaces have distinct visual weight.

stateClarity.criterion: Focus, primary, selected, checked, busy, error, and disabled states cannot be confused.

cohesion.criterion: Qt, Plasma, session, window, icon, cursor, brand, and wallpaper layers read as one system.

branding.criterion: The mark and wallpaper are mature, original, legible, and quieter than application content.

density.criterion: Spacing and typography establish structure before borders and boxes.

motion.criterion: Supported transitions are purposeful, bounded, idle-free, and reduced-motion safe.

accessibility.criterion: Contrast, system font, keyboard, RTL, scale, and non-color cues remain complete.

fallbackBehavior.criterion: Unsupported controls and blur-off or compositor-limited surfaces remain usable and honest.
